nodes.text: Haunted Thursday favorites 🏆 Three haunts that stopped my scroll. @juliahh @bugs_eye_view_of_you @tiffany.art2020 - beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/De1xcL1E2Sh/
photos: A life-sized skeleton dressed in a black robe and hat stands behind a glass front door, bathed in the warm, bright glow of an indoor light at night.
A large, plastic, cream-colored Halloween skeleton appears to be bursting out of the grass in a front yard, with fake spider webs draped over the bushes and porch behind it.
An eerie photo shows an illuminated white human skeleton standing against a textured, rustic brown backdrop.

replies.text: The doorway glow makes her look caught mid-visit. Whose doorway is she haunting, and does she stay up year-round? @juliahh
Thank you for that, feel very honored. ☺️
He climbed out and immediately struck a pose. How long does the full lawn setup take you each year? @bugs_eye_view_of_you
Hi, this belongs to my neighbor. They put it up October 1st every year. I love how realistic it looks.
Thank you!
That rust-and-grunge finish - is the texture in the shot or in the edit? Either way it looks printed on old metal. @tiffany.art2020

nodes.snippet: Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thing in your camer…
nodes.text: Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thing in your camera roll. A sunflower, a sunset, a streetlamp glowing at dusk - if it glows gold, it counts. Fog and first light on my street - all gold for about a minute. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Best of the week lands on Instagram on the weekend.
photos: Sunlight filters through the misty air of a quiet residential street, casting dramatic rays over autumn-colored trees and a parked truck.

Description: A coastal town skyline sits on the horizon under a golden sunset, with its lights beginning to twinkle across a flat, reflective expanse of wet sand or shallow water. The warm, luminous glow creates a tranquil evening mood ideal for sharing a coastal travel moment. Photograph read: The horizontal composition uses a centered urban silhouette set against a vast monochrome tidal flat, bathed in warm golden light that creates a serene and quiet atmosphere.

replies.text: Winter Park, CO at golden hour 🏔️
photos: Description: A vibrant orange and purple sunrise lights up the cloudy sky over a snowy valley surrounded by dark, rolling mountains. In the foreground, a frosty garden fence and a snow-dusted evergreen tree frame the tranquil morning scene. Photograph read: The wide-angle composition contrasts the warm, glowing horizon with the cool tones of the frost-covered landscape, creating a peaceful and serene mood.

replies.text: At the Grapevine Meow Wolf
photos: Description: A gallery wall displays various whimsical, painted ceramic or clay heads mounted on individual small shelves against a dark patterned wallpaper. The eccentric collection includes a blue horned creature, a white rabbit, a frowning woman in a red headscarf, and other colorful, expressive faces. Photograph read: The straight-on composition emphasizes the whimsical arrangement of colorful sculptures, captured under warm indoor lighting that casts soft shadows and creates a playful, theatrical mood.

replies.text: What glows brighter than Dolly??
photos: Description: A large boulder outdoors features a vibrant painting of Dolly Parton styled like a religious icon, with a gold-painted halo against a clear blue sky. The artwork is framed by a dusty dirt path, dry brush, and green trees. Photograph read: The centered, medium shot uses bright, direct sunlight to cast stark shadows on the boulder, creating a vibrant, celebratory mood against the deep blue sky.

Description: A calm, hazy morning scene features a grassy field bordered by silhouetted trees with sunlight breaking through the low-hanging fog and lighting the horizon. Photograph read: The vertical framing emphasizes the vast gradient of the blue sky above the darker field, while backlit trees create a serene, atmospheric mood.

Description: A wide rural landscape stretches beneath a fiery orange sunset, with silhouetted mountains in the distance and a wire fence cutting across the foreground. The warm glow creates a peaceful, rustic scene ideal for sharing a quiet evening view. Photograph read: The horizontal composition uses layered silhouettes of the fence and mountains to anchor the frame, while the warm directional light from the sunset sets a tranquil, serene mood.

Description: A thin, bare tree stands near the edge of a calm pond as wisps of morning mist rise from the water's surface. In the background, a dense tree line displays autumn foliage in shades of gold, orange, and green under a clear blue sky. Photograph read: The centered subject creates a balanced, peaceful composition bathed in warm morning light that enhances the serene and quiet mood.

replies.text: One thin bare tree holding the foreground while the treeline behind it goes gold, mist still lifting off the pond. How early were you out?

photos: Description: A line of five dark birds flies low across the glistening waters of a bay at sunset, with rolling green hills visible in the distance beneath a dramatic, cloudy sky. This serene coastal scene is perfect for a nature post celebrating the peaceful close of the day. Photograph read: The wide-angle landscape composition uses strong horizontal lines and dramatic backlit golden hour lighting to create a calm yet atmospheric mood, centered on the striking silhouettes of the flying birds against the sun's glittering reflection.

replies.text: Five birds crossing the sun's glitter path in a line - that's timing, not luck, at that height over the water. Tracking them in, or did they cross your frame?

photos: Description: A bright, almost white sun hangs centrally in a thick, amber-hued sky above distant, dark mountains. The monochromatic, golden-orange atmosphere suggests a hazy day or smoke-filled air, making this a striking image for posts about weather, sunsets, or environmental conditions. Photograph read: The monochromatic warm palette and high-key exposure emphasize the hazy, diffuse light, creating a stark, moody contrast with the silhouetted hills and sparse branches below.

replies.text: Sun dead center and the whole sky flattened into one amber wash. Smoke in the air, or just a heavy hazy evening?
A foggy sunrise in Springvale Twp.
photos: Description: A barren tree stands in a misty field at sunrise, with a bright orange glow rising over a distant treeline. This serene, atmospheric landscape evokes a quiet morning in the countryside. Photograph read: The wide-angle composition uses rule of thirds placement for the skeletal tree, creating a melancholic mood enhanced by the soft morning light diffusing through the low-lying fog.

replies.text: A skeletal tree in fog with the glow building behind the treeline - restraint everywhere. Does Springvale give you many mornings like this?
Not sure! Being retired, I'm usually not out and about at this hour!

photos: Description: A bright orange and yellow single rose is centered in the frame, featuring delicate overlapping petals and a prominent cluster of golden stamens at its core. A single water droplet rests on the lower petal, set against a backdrop of green leaves and dark gravel. Photograph read: The top-down composition captures the flower in natural daylight, creating a vibrant and tranquil mood against the textured, out-of-focus background.

replies.text: Top-down on the rose and the stamens become the subject, droplet included. Your garden?
Yes it’s in my front yard.
After the rain. *shot on iPhone
photos: Description: A brightly lit corner building housing "Bistrot de la Gare" stands out against a dark, rainy night in Paris, with pedestrians holding umbrellas walking along the wet, reflective sidewalk. The warm yellow glow from the streetlights and restaurant windows creates a cozy, inviting atmosphere amid the damp city environment. Photograph read: The wide-angle, eye-level shot captures a vibrant night scene with strong contrast between the warm artificial lighting and the dark sky, enhanced by mirror-like reflections on the wet asphalt.

replies.text: Warm windows against a wet Paris night, the sidewalk doubling every light. How long does that mirror last before the pavement dries?

photos: Description: A vibrant orange sunset glows over the ocean, viewed from a balcony overlooking a rocky coastline and a patio area below. This serene evening landscape makes a great scenic post for travel or coastal relaxation. Photograph read: The horizontally banded composition frames the glowing sky above a dark sea, creating a calm and tranquil mood under natural twilight illumination.

replies.text: Glowing band of sky over a dark sea, balcony framing giving it scale. Is this a view you get to keep, or a trip?
Last vacation. Pismo Beach CA
This is Izaak!
photos: Description: A joyful golden retriever looks directly at the camera with its mouth wide open, its long tongue dangling out. The dog's fluffy fur and happy expression make this a great photo to share on social media to brighten someone's day. Photograph read: The subject is centered in a medium close-up against a heavily blurred green background, creating a bright and cheerful mood with natural, diffused lighting.

replies.text: Eye-level with Izaak and that blurred green backdrop makes the gold coat pop. Tongue out on cue, or does he just live like that?
That’s just how he rolls! Ha ha

photos: Description: Three male golfers stand together on a green during golden hour, posing with their putters near a flagstick with a bright yellow flag. In the background, a low-angle sun casts warm light across the landscape, silhouetting distant trees and mountains beyond a narrow body of water. Photograph read: The wide-angle composition places the subjects centrally, while the low golden-hour sun creates strong backlighting and long shadows that evoke a relaxed and nostalgic mood.

replies.text: Backlit group shot and nobody falls to silhouette - the low sun rims all three of you, and that yellow flag steals the frame. Eighteen holes in, or posing before the round?
End of the round 🙂
Long walk, Claddagh, Galway city, Ireland
photos: Description: A person jogs along a paved harbor walkway during twilight as glowing holiday lights illuminate nearby trees and a distant building facade. Moored sailboats gently rock in the dark water, which reflects the warm golden lights against a deep blue evening sky. Photograph read: The wide-angle horizontal composition uses a strong leading line of the harbor wall to draw the eye toward the distant horizon, while the contrast of warm festive lights against the cool twilight creates a calm, serene mood.

replies.text: Warm lights against the deep blue hour, and the harbor wall pulls you right through the frame. How far does that walk run?
The last sunrise out of the first house I bought on my own. Bittersweet.
photos: Description: A hazy sunrise peeks through a natural tree frame, illuminating a rural scene with a distant water tower and a barn roof. The moody landscape evokes a quiet, early morning small-town vibe. Photograph read: The framing created by dark, silhouetted foliage creates a natural vignette around the glowing, overcast sky, establishing a still and atmospheric mood.

replies.text: The trees make a natural vignette around that hazy sky - a quiet frame for a goodbye. Did you stand in this same spot for it on other mornings?
I did. Many times. I loved how the town water tower was just in my line of sight. I would have some morning coffee and watch the day wake up. Me and Jesus talking about the day. 🙂
Wow 🤩

photos: Description: A high-angle nighttime shot captures a neatly paved stone walkway flanked by a garden bed illuminated by two small, glowing ground lights. The warm light from the fixtures casts a gentle, inviting ambiance over the foliage, dark soil, and the clean edge of the pathway, perfect for an evening stroll post. Photograph read: The high-angle diagonal composition creates natural leading lines down the tiled pathway, while the warm, localized lighting contrasts sharply against the deep night shadows to establish a quiet, cozy mood.

replies.text: High angle down the path, and two little lights do all the work against the night. Your garden, or a walk you take often?
No, was taken in Mallorca whilst on holiday. Was actually a row of them, but couldn't get the focus right
Golden glow
photos: Description: A golden sunset casts brilliant light across a calm expanse of water, with sunbeams piercing through the cloud layer. In the foreground, the silhouettes of two wading birds stand near the ruins of an old concrete pier. Photograph read: The vertical composition creates a natural division between the luminous sky and dark foreground elements, establishing a serene yet melancholic mood through strong backlit silhouettes.

replies.text: Two tiny bird silhouettes hold the foreground while the sky goes huge. Are those herons?
Yes, they are herons . This was taken from the edge of my yard .

photos: Description: A dense line of dark evergreen trees stands in front of a vibrant golden-orange sunset sky filled with textured clouds. Several utility wires stretch horizontally across the upper portion of the frame, contrasting with the natural landscape. Photograph read: The symmetrical horizontal composition stacks dark foreground vegetation against a brilliant amber sky, creating a moody twilight atmosphere.

Description: A hazy, monochromatic golden sunset casts a warm glow over a paved road flanked by tall light poles and silhouetted trees. Power lines stretch horizontally across the upper sky, framing the tranquil evening landscape. Photograph read: The wide-angle composition uses layered silhouettes of light poles and trees to lead the eye toward the brilliant sun, creating a calm, atmospheric evening mood bathed in golden light.

Description: A close-up shot of a golden retriever resting in a patch of green grass, tilting its head slightly with a gentle expression. The warm sunlight highlights its golden coat and dark, expressive eyes, perfect for a pet-appreciation post. Photograph read: The tight vertical framing focuses entirely on the dog's expressive face against a textured background of green grass, creating an intimate, warm portrait.

replies.text: Three frames, three kinds of gold - sky, road, and the dog who steals the set. Was the retriever shot the same evening?
All different days😊

photos: Description: A sunlit park field is framed by large trees, with golden late-afternoon light casting long shadows across the grass. The central tree glows with reddish-orange autumn foliage while the setting sun peeks through the branches on the right. Photograph read: The wide-angle composition uses the framing of the foreground trees to lead the eye toward the bright sunburst on the right, creating a warm, peaceful mood bathed in golden hour light.

replies.text: Trees framing trees, and the sunburst lands exactly where the frame opens. That central red one is showing off - local park?

photos: Description: A tranquil coastal scene at dusk, featuring silhouettes of dark rocks scattered in shallow water under a gradient sky of gold and blue. The calm water reflects the soft colors of the sunset, creating a peaceful and serene atmosphere ideal for nature appreciation or evening reflection. Photograph read: The vertical composition uses a low-angle perspective to emphasize the dark, silhouetted rocks against a softly lit horizon, creating a calm and contemplative mood.

replies.text: Low angle, so the rocks sit black against that gradient. Long exposure, or was the water really that still?
Really still night in western part of Finland. We have bright nights during midsummer here here .

photos: Description: This macro shot presents a tight, extreme close-up of shiny, corrugated metal ridges stretching diagonally across the frame. The repetitive zig-zag patterns create an abstract, industrial texture with a moody, dark background. Photograph read: The composition uses a shallow depth of field to isolate a sharp, brightly lit central ridge, while the foreground and background blur into soft gradients, creating a sleek and atmospheric mood.

replies.text: Diagonal ridges and a shallow slice of focus - one bright ridge carries the whole abstract. Do you know what the metal actually is?
It’s a card of bobby pins :)

photos: Description: A bright sun sets near a mountainous coastline, casting a golden reflection across calm ocean waters and onto a wet sandy beach. Gentle waves lap at the shore, creating a serene coastal view perfect for a peaceful evening social media post. Photograph read: The horizontal composition uses natural framing and strong sidelighting to create a tranquil, golden-hour mood that emphasizes the contrast between dark silhouettes and glowing reflections.

replies.text: The reflection runs from the water straight onto the wet sand - two mirrors in one frame. Which coast is this?
The sea of Cortez, San Carlos Mexico.

photos: Description: Two people are silhouetted against a brilliant orange and pink sunset while standing in the shallows of a beach with gentle waves. The dramatic sky and reflective wet sand create a serene and scenic coastal backdrop ideal for sharing a peaceful evening moment. Photograph read: Strong backlighting casts the two figures into dark silhouettes, creating a moody, contemplative tone centered by the central vertical placement of the foreground subject.

replies.text: Two figures in the shallows, backlit to pure silhouette, wet sand doubling the sky. Did you wade in yourself, or shoot from dry sand?
We were all barefoot. As the tide was coming in. This is in manzanita Oregon. Absolutely beautiful place.

photos: Description: A path winds through a canopy of tall trees with vibrant yellow autumn foliage under a clear blue sky. On the right, contrasting green and silver-leafed shrubs line the trail, with dappled sunlight casting shadows on the leaf-strewn ground. Photograph read: Taken from a low-angle perspective, the vertical composition emphasizes the towering height of the central autumn tree against a bright blue sky, creating a serene and crisp autumn mood with stark natural contrasts.

Description: Two tall-masted sailing vessels silhouette against a fiery orange sunset over the ocean, with scattered clouds catching the warm light of the sinking sun. The serene coastal scene evokes a peaceful evening on the water, ideal for a travel or nature post. Photograph read: The centered horizon divides the frame between a dramatic, cloud-dusted amber sky and dark water, creating a tranquil yet striking mood through strong backlit silhouettes.

Description: Rugged, snow-dusted mountain peaks rise above a flat meadow and a line of dark pine trees, set against a dramatic sky filled with vivid, glowing yellow and orange clouds. This striking landscape photo makes a compelling post for nature lovers, travel enthusiasts, or anyone sharing a dramatic sunset view. Photograph read: The horizontal composition layers a dark foreground forest, a pale grassy field, and a massive mountain range under a high-contrast sky saturated in brilliant golden tones that create a fiery, intense mood.

replies.text: Three landscapes, three kinds of gold - autumn path, tall ships, snow-dusted peaks. One trip, or a camera-roll greatest hits?
Phone photos greatest hits.

photos: Description: A vibrant sunset glows directly ahead at the end of a paved road, viewed from the driver's seat of a car. Utility poles and silhouetted trees line the roadside beneath a blue sky streaked with wispy clouds and contrails. Photograph read: The symmetrical placement of the glowing sun and utility pole creates a central axis against the silhouetted horizon, casting a warm, hazy light that evokes a serene, evening commute mood.

replies.text: Straight down the road's axis, sun dead ahead - the view everyone knows but nobody frames this clean. Daily commute, or a road you chose for the light?
Golden Muchroom
photos: Description: An extreme macro shot focuses on the textured, glowing surface of a rotting pumpkin, with a dark cavity resembling an eye peering through tall, silhouetted grass blades. The rich autumn hues and earthy decay evoke a moody, Halloween-inspired aesthetic. Photograph read: The extreme close-up composition uses dramatic high-contrast lighting to cast deep shadows across the organic textures, creating an eerie and mysterious mood.

replies.text: Macro on a rotting pumpkin and it turns creature-like - that dark cavity reads as an eye through the grass. Found it like that, or went hunting for decay?
i saw it while walking the dog, so i went for it. Up and close with my iphone.
iPhone 17 ProMax
photos: A breathtaking view of a wildfire creates a dramatic sky filled with vibrant shades of orange and yellow, casting an eerie glow over the landscape. The dark silhouettes of trees stand out sharply against the fiery backdrop, emphasizing the intensity and power of the natural event.

replies.text: You let the trees go black and gave the whole frame to that sky. Smoke does what no filter can - was this from a safe distance, or closer than you'd have liked?
That was morning fog actually. I took it from my balcony using 8x telephoto I think.

photos: Against a dusky sky, a golden cloud formation resembles a dragon breathing fire. The silhouette of a street lamp is visible at the bottom left.

replies.text: You caught that cloud mid-breath - a dragon like that exists for about two minutes. The little street lamp anchors the scale. Already out watching the sky, or did it stop you mid-walk?
Picture taken from my car
Last photo of my dog. 🐶🪽✨
photos: A small white and tan terrier mix wearing a blue mesh harness lies comfortably on a brown textured armchair, looking intently to the side. Nearby toys suggest a cozy indoor setting, perfect for a relaxed pet portrait.

replies.text: A quiet portrait - soft indoor light, head turned like he's listening for something. Last photos carry a weight the others don't. How long was he with you?
Pakistan
photos: Golden sunlight casts a warm glow on the snow-capped peaks of towering mountains, contrasting sharply with the deep, cool shadows of the rocky slopes below.

replies.text: Alpenglow doing the work - warm caps, cold shadows, all in one frame. Which range is this, and were you shooting from another slope or down in the valley?
From the valley and I think this was in the Karakoram, since we were mainly in the Gilgit region.

photos: A vibrant orange sunset illuminates a mountain range with a rugged trail winding up a slope in the foreground.

replies.text: The trail is the picture - one lit path pulling you into all that orange. Was this the walk back down at the end of a hike?
This was the way up. This is sunrise, as you have to start early to avoid afternoon thunderstorms. It is 14,000ft summit. The way back down is the same route.

photos: Golden sunlight filters through a misty, autumnal forest, casting dramatic rays over a forest floor covered in fallen brown leaves. Tall trees stand on a sloping hill, creating a serene and magical morning landscape.

replies.text: Rays like that need mist and timing - a few minutes either way and they're gone. How early were you out for this one?
I mean, it was around 9 o’clock one day in November. A small mountain peak in the Bavarian Alps…
My golden eye!
photos: A glowing, bright yellow sun hovers over a silhouetted treeline and body of water, casting brilliant orange and yellow light across a dramatic sky of layered clouds.

replies.text: You exposed for the sun and let everything else fall to silhouette, so that disc just hovers. Zoomed in tight, or cropped down after?
No just a shot off my balcony!

photos: A vast field of vibrant yellow wildflowers stretches out beneath a cloudy sky, with two palm trees standing near a body of water in the distance.

replies.text: Shot low across the flowers so the field runs forever, palms holding the horizon. Florida?

photos: An impressionistic painting of a flock of sandhill cranes stands on a rustic wooden tabletop. The textured artwork captures the elegant birds in shades of gray, orange, and white, with their characteristic red crests highlighted against a muted background.

replies.text: You shot the painting straight-on so the paint texture holds, and those red crests pop against all the gray. Your own work? How big is the piece?
It is my original. 16"x20"
An April sunrise over the rooftops of Bắc Giang.
photos: A bright, hazy sun casts a golden glow over a densely packed city skyline at dawn. The warm yellow light bathes the rooftops and buildings in a dreamlike, hazy atmosphere.

replies.text: Haze as a softbox - the whole skyline goes dreamlike instead of hard-edged. Your own rooftop, or a balcony you hunted down?
12th floor of my apartment building. ￼ the farmers were burning rice straw after the harvest. Not great for the lungs but it does wonders for a moody sunrise😊
Bonavista, Newfoundland
photos: A vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of orange and pink over a tranquil ocean. A weathered wooden fence runs along the rocky shoreline, leading the eye toward a small, red cottage perched on the cliffside.

replies.text: That fence is a perfect leading line - it walks you straight to the red cottage. Did you drop to the fence's height to keep it running diagonal?
Standing straight. Lay of the land was a perfect set up.

photos: Looking straight up at a circular, domed ceiling, this image captures a detailed golden sunburst with a glowing Eye of Providence at its center. The burst is set against a vibrant red circular background, surrounded by decorative panels radiating outwards in pale green and gold.

replies.text: Straight-up and dead center - a sunburst like that punishes any tilt. Where is this ceiling?

photos: A vibrant orange sun sets over a calm body of water, framed by the dark, intricate branches of trees in the foreground. The sky glows with warm hues, casting a serene light on the distant mountains and rocky shoreline below.

replies.text: Framing the sunset inside the branches - the dark lace gives the glow something to push against. Lake or coast?

photos: A view overlooking a coastal city shows sun rays breaking through clouds during sunset or sunrise. The hazy, sepia-toned light casts a warm glow over the water, distant hills, and dark silhouettes of trees in the foreground.

replies.text: Rays fanning through the cloud break - you caught the moment the sky opened. Were you up high, hilltop or a top-floor window?
From my balcony, top floor

photos: A vibrant, golden-yellow cactus flower is in full bloom against a dark, out-of-focus background. Sharp, spiky thorns surround the delicate blossom, highlighting the contrast between the plant's harsh defenses and its soft, luminous petals.

replies.text: Golden petals against near-black - the exposure isolates the bloom completely. Flash, or just shade at the right hour?

photos: A high-angle view captures a city skyline silhouetted against a dramatic sunset with gold and grey clouds. In the foreground, illuminated parking garages and palm trees anchor the urban scene.

replies.text: High vantage, skyline gone silhouette, garages sparkling underneath. Rooftop, or a parking deck of your own?
Fort Lauderdale hotel window 😊

photos: A close-up, high-angle shot reveals the textured surface of crinkled, shiny cellophane or plastic wrap, catching warm light that creates bright, glittering highlights across its uneven expanse.

replies.text: Macro on crinkled cellophane, and every fold is catching its own highlight - a field of tiny mirrors. What was the light, straight window sun?
Bubble wrap with sun coming through the window.

photos: The "Welcome to Roswell" sign stands tall in a flat, arid landscape under a cloudy sunset sky, featuring a UFO on top and graffiti on its base. The quirky monument highlights the area's famous UFO lore, making it a must-visit roadside stop for alien enthusiasts.

replies.text: Damn!!! Beautiful!!!
Straight-on and low, so the UFO on top lands against that sky. Roadside signs live or die on what's behind them - did you wait for this light?

photos: A caravan of silhouetted camels and riders crests a sand dune against a vibrant sunset sky that fades from deep orange to pale blue. This picturesque desert scene evokes a serene and adventurous travel vibe.

replies.text: You put the caravan right on the crest line so the silhouettes read clean against the gradient. Were you down in the sand, shooting up at them?
I took this photo from a distance at eye level, using a mobile phone.
Golden light underground inside a drained old cistern.
photos: This low-angle vertical shot shows an underground room with a high ceiling supported by concrete arches. The concrete columns frame the room, and there is a wet floor.

replies.text: Low angle, arches carrying the whole frame, wet floor doubling what little light there is. How did you get access down there?
You can access it by visiting the art exhibitions held down there. I come here every year because they change the exhibition every year!

photos: A vertical, outdoor shot captures a vibrant sunset against a pale sky filled with light, wispy, horizontal clouds, tinged with a warm, golden glow in the center. A roofline with trees on either side anchors the bottom of the image, while the silhouette of a tree frames the left side.

replies.text: You gave the sky four-fifths of the frame and let the roofline just anchor it. Was this the peak of the glow, or did it build after?
It quickly disappeared

photos: A dense forest of tall trees is bathed in warm, golden sunlight filtering through the canopy, creating a peaceful and serene atmosphere. The vibrant green leaves and glowing light make it a perfect backdrop for a nature-loving social media post.

replies.text: Backlit canopy - you shot into the light and let the leaves glow instead of flattening green. Did the light find you on the path, or did you go looking for the gap?
I was the passenger in a car and happened to look to my right and saw this light and quickly snapped a photo. ￼￼

photos: A lone bird soars high in the pale sky against a backdrop of hazy, rolling hills and a soft sunset glow.

replies.text: All that negative space with one bird in it - that's a patience shot. How long were you watching that sky before it crossed?
I think i was just shooting..
Sunrise by the lake in my neighborhood
photos: A flock of seagulls takes flight from a wooden dock overlooking a serene lake during a golden sunset, with dark forest treelines lining the horizon under a cloudy sky.

replies.text: You caught the gulls mid-liftoff, so a still lake gets a burst of motion. One lucky burst, or were you set up on that dock a while?
My husband usually put some sunflower seeds for them most mornings. We love the feeding frenzy...lots of action
Sunrise in the Churnet Valley, Staffordshire, September.
photos: A row of silhouetted trees stands against a vibrant sunset sky that transitions from bright orange near the horizon to soft pink and purple above. The stark contrast between the dark trees and the colorful twilight creates a peaceful and moody atmosphere.

replies.text: You let the trees go full silhouette and kept every layer of that sky, orange up to violet. Did you expose for the sky and let the valley fall to black on purpose?

I did in that pic...and it was only with this crappy old Samsung phone camera. Took this one a few seconds before. Usually phone cameras do not do sunrise/set colours justice, they just bleach everything out. But I think I got this because the sun wasn't over the horizon yet.
photos: A vibrant sunset with streaks of purple and pink paints the sky behind the dark silhouettes of trees, creating a serene and picturesque view.

replies.text: That's the trick - shooting before the sun clears the horizon keeps the color stacked instead of bleached. This earlier frame proves it: moodier sky, same control. Phone cameras owe you an apology.

photos: A bright sun sets behind a silhouetted treeline, casting a warm golden glow over a verdant park at dusk. Wispy, scattered clouds create an ethereal backdrop in the evening sky, perfect for a peaceful nature post.

replies.text: Treeline kept low, sun sitting right on it, and the glow spills into the bottom third. Your local park, or were you passing through?
The park where I walk my dog every day.

photos: A vibrant golden and dark cloud-filled sunset spreads across the horizon, casting a warm glow over a calm body of water and a silhouetted shoreline.

replies.text: Shot low across the water so the reflection doubles the sky. That dark cloud mass pressing on the glow - did it really sit that heavy, or did you lean into it in the exposure?
I played with the exposure just a little but the color was amazing

photos: A low-angle shot captures a red metal truss bridge against a bright, hazy sky at sunset. Tall, feathery grasses line the foreground, illuminated by the warm, golden light of the sun peeking from beneath the bridge.
A close-up shot of tall, feathery grasses sways gently in a field at sunset, their delicate plumes catching the warm, golden light of the fading sun.
A striking, golden-flowered tree stands centered against a setting sun, creating a luminous silhouette. The tranquil rural scene is complemented by train tracks running in the background.

A low-angle, eye-level shot captures a modern pedestrian bridge featuring sweeping, tubular steel arches and a curved walkway, with bright sunlight breaking through the structure. The sunlight creates a vibrant starburst effect at the center of the frame and a horizontal lens flare stretching across the image, casting long shadows across the pathway.

replies.text: Low angle under the truss bridge with the sun sneaking beneath it, then a starburst straight through those steel arches - you worked the sun from every side today. Two bridges in one set: same river, or did you go bridge-hunting across town?
These are two completely different locations. You could call this a kind of bridge hunting. I love the afternoon sunlight, and I also like to plan my photography routes in advance.

A macro shot shows a row of six clear, glistening water droplets balanced precariously along the edge of a vibrant green blade of grass, capturing the delicate beauty of a rainy morning. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blend of muted greens and whites, creating a serene and contemplative atmosphere.
A person wearing a hat pilots a small motorized dinghy through calm harbor waters, with a passenger resting nearby. In the background, numerous sailboats are anchored against a hazy shoreline.

The dog at the bow - regular first mate, or a one-time passenger? @garnome

nodes.snippet: Haunted Thursday 🎃 Show me your Halloween. Pumpkin patches,…
nodes.text: Haunted Thursday 🎃 Show me your Halloween. Pumpkin patches, porch carvings, decorations, foggy corners, odd shadows - festive or full-on creepy, all of it counts. This big guy is on pumpkin duty all October. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Best of the week lands on Instagram on the weekend.
photos: A full-sized skeleton stands in a front yard as part of a Halloween decoration, leaning on a weed whacker. Three carved plastic pumpkins rest on the grass in front of it.

A dimly lit restaurant corridor is decorated for a magical or witchy theme, featuring floating candles, witch hats, and a rose-covered archway. The ceiling sparkles with purple fairy lights, creating an enchanting ambiance as patrons dine inside.

A dark corridor, reminiscent of the Great Hall at Hogwarts, is adorned with floating candles and wizard hats suspended from the ceiling. The walls are lined with vintage, dark-framed portraits, and a door at the end glows with blue light, displaying a graphic of a long hallway.

A humorous Hocus Pocus-themed t-shirt reads, "Sanderson Sisters Bed and Breakfast Kids Stay Free." The background features a watercolor wash of orange, purple, and green behind black silhouettes of witches flying on brooms.

replies.text: That corridor is all one-point perspective - floating candles pulling the eye straight to the blue-lit door at the end. Planned center frame, or did you find it walking in?
Found it walking in and loved it ! Btw yours is so fun!!!!

photos: An orange cat peeks from beneath pumpkins on the porch of a yellow house, which is festively decorated with autumn decor like pumpkins and leaves.

replies.text: There's a whole porch pageant here, and the best part is hiding behind the left stove - a cream cat slipping past the pumpkins. Was he part of the display, or did he photobomb his own porch?

photos: A tall ghost-like grim reaper figure stands next to a lamppost, draped in tattered grey fabric and with a skeletal head and hands, outside a house with a blue exterior and white porch. The front porch is heavily decorated for Halloween, featuring another skeleton, a "Graveyard" sign, and orange pumpkins with goofy expressions amidst potted plants.

replies.text: Shooting the reaper slightly from below buys him the extra height - he towers against that house properly. Was the lamppost his post, or your framing luck?
It was his post. Thank you for your input! 🙂
Haha, thank you for your post 👍

photos: An unsettling close-up shot depicts the upper body and skull of a human skeleton, overlaid with a grunge texture. The image is bathed in a dark and somber red hue, creating a spooky and gothic mood, perfect for Halloween.

replies.text: Red light, grunge, and a skeleton who has seen things. That's a poster, not a decoration.

photos: A cozy corner features cheerful Halloween decorations, including several white-sheet ghosts wearing witch hats, a basket overflowing with plush pumpkins, and a decorated tree branch. Sunlight streams through large windows behind the festive display, highlighting a playful indoor holiday setup.

replies.text: Sheet ghosts in witch hats, sun streaming in - the friendliest haunting on the thread. The plush pumpkins are well guarded.
Treat Street goes all out
photos: At night, people wearing Halloween costumes gather on a sloped residential street. The street slopes downward toward the brightly lit skyscrapers of a city in the distance, and cars are parked on either side of the road.

replies.text: A whole street of costumes sloping down toward the skyline. Treat Street understood the assignment at scale.
The whole street gets decorated, haunted houses in garages, bar setups for adults, every house goes all out.
photos: An illuminated Halloween animatronic of a creepy girl with glowing eyes swings on a rope in front of a building at night.

An indoor Halloween graveyard display features multiple gravestones lit by strings of warm yellow fairy lights and tiny orange candles, with scattered skulls and skeletal hands rising from the green ground. The spooky scene is set against a backdrop of blue-lit plastic sheeting and wood-paneled walls, complete with a lone wooden chair and an altar draped in a spiderweb-covered cloth in the back.

A group of people wearing costumes are gathered outside a house at night for a Halloween party, with colorful lights illuminating the scene. A red tent with "Area 1594 Check-In" signs stands at the entrance, surrounded by caution tape and spooky decorations.

Three children in diverse Halloween costumes pose joyfully together in front of a house, their faces illuminated by colorful glow necklaces. The one on the left is wrapped in white bandages like a mummy, the middle child wears a pirate hat and dark jacket, and the one on the right sports long reddish-brown hair and a blue jacket with studded details.

replies.text: The whole street goes all out - haunted houses in garages AND bar setups for the adults. Treat Street runs a full Halloween department. The swinging greeter at the door is a strong door policy.
SF takes Halloween seriously.. 😆
Happy Halloween
photos: A toddler in brown and white striped pajamas and a black and red cape plays with a carved pumpkin on a porch.

A skeleton dressed as a Victorian-era person, complete with a dark coat and hat, stands in the warmly lit entryway of a home, framed by a large window. The spooky yet amusing display hints at Halloween celebrations.

replies.text: Dressed for the parlor and waiting by the window. Victorian manners, Halloween patience.

photos: A rustic wooden folding stool sits against a brick wall, holding a galvanized metal watering can and a small, two-toned orange pumpkin. To the left, part of a bicycle wheel and another metal bucket add to the weathered, autumn-themed display on the porch.

replies.text: A porch that whispers instead of shouts. The little two-tone pumpkin runs the whole arrangement.
why thank you 🥹

photos: A weathered, blue and red truck bed is creatively decorated as a festive autumn and Halloween display, topped with a large, grinning metal alligator. Pumpkins, ghosts, and various whimsical decorations surround the vehicle in a welcoming seasonal setup.

replies.text: A grinning metal alligator riding in a truck bed full of pumpkins - this display stopped improving and kept going anyway. The ghosts approve.

photos: A menacing, black-and-white-clad killer clown glares into the camera, brandishing a bloody knife in one hand while reaching out threateningly with the other. The dramatic, shadowy lighting and sinister makeup create the ultimate horror-movie vibe, perfect for Halloween thrills.

replies.text: Full horror-movie energy, straight into the lens. You did not come to decorate, you came to menace.

photos: A black and white, low-angle, vertical photo captures a narrow, brick-walled alleyway at night. A wrought-iron fence frames the bottom, featuring vertical spikes and scrollwork designs. Beyond the fence, stone steps ascend through the tight space, illuminated by two vintage wall-mounted lamps. The primary lamp in the lower-left foreground is large and bright, while the smaller lamp is positioned further up the dark alley. The stark contrast between the bright lights and dark shadows creates a moody, gothic atmosphere.

replies.text: Brick, lamplight, and an iron fence doing atmosphere overtime. That alley was haunted long before Halloween.

photos: A tall, spooky Halloween decoration featuring a grinning pumpkin head and a hunchbacked, gaunt body stands in front of a house, its tattered greenish-yellow robes draped over tree-bark-textured limbs as its long, clawed fingers reach forward.

replies.text: A pumpkin-headed greeter with claws like that does not need a doorbell. Nobody's ringing twice.

photos: A headless figure stands on a path covered in leaves, with a glowing jack-o'-lantern held where their head should be.

replies.text: Headless, but still carrying the pumpkin with total confidence. The leaves on the path finish the whole look.

photos: A large, plastic, human-like skeleton emerges from a patch of green grass in front of a house decorated for Halloween. The decoration consists of the skeleton's upper body and a pair of outstretched arms, with the hands resting on the grass, surrounded by fake spiderwebs and dead leaves.

replies.text: Climbing out of the lawn and already posing. The spiderwebs say he's been down there a while.

photos: A spooky Halloween display features an archway of glowing purple skulls and a skeleton playing a green guitar beneath it. In the background, a pirate statue and a graveyard scene complete the yard's festive decor.

replies.text: A skull archway AND a skeleton on guitar duty - this yard has a full production budget. The pirate running security in the back completes it.

photos: An eye-level, medium shot depicts a dark wooden bench with concrete legs sitting on a small concrete platform facing a body of water during the autumn season. A fallen, brown autumn leaf rests on a bed of dewy grass, surrounded by a glistening field of water droplets that catch the light in a soft, dreamy blur.

Perfectly calculated 👍👍👍
